4 slices whole wheat bread: 3–4 lettuce leaves
Half a bunch dill, 1 pinch black pepper
Mash the curd cheese with olive oil, chopped dill and black pepper.
Thinly slice the cucumber and tomato.
Spread the curd cheese mixture on the bread.
Layer the lettuce, cucumber and tomato and close.
Cut diagonally and serve.
Add the tomato last so the bread does not get soggy.
Right away or in a lunch box.
Eat the same day.
Lentil soup
Rinse the lentils; chop the onion and carrot.
Heat the oil in a pot and stir the onion and carrot for 3 minutes.
Add the lentils and water and cook for 20 minutes until soft.
Tomato soup
Grate the tomatoes.
Toast the flour in oil for 1 minute and add the tomato.
Add the water gradually while stirring.
Cook for 15 minutes, strain and serve.
Bulgur pilaf with vegetables
Dice the vegetables small.
Sauté the vegetables in oil for 5 minutes.
Add the bulgur, stir and add the hot water.
Cook covered over low heat until the water is absorbed.
Baked chicken and potatoes
400 g boneless chicken
Preheat the oven to 200 °C.
Slice the potatoes and place them with the chicken in a baking dish.
Add the oil and thyme and toss.
Bake for about 35–45 minutes until the chicken reaches an internal temperature of at least 74 °C.
Banana oat pancakes
4 tablespoons fine oats
Add the egg and oats and mix.
Pour small portions into a lightly greased pan.
Turn until both sides are cooked through.
Purslane with yogurt
1 small clove garlic
Wash the purslane well and dry.
Mix the yogurt with crushed garlic.
Add the purslane and toss.
Zucchini fritters (mücver)
Grate the zucchini and squeeze out the liquid.
Mix with the egg, flour and dill.
Put the mixture in small portions in a greased pan.
Cook both sides until the inside is fully cooked.
Baked cauliflower
1 teaspoon paprika
Separate the cauliflower into florets, wash and dry.
Toss with oil and spices and spread on the tray.
Bake for 25–30 minutes until easily pierced with a fork.
Zucchini stuffed with minced meat
4 medium zucchini
1 tablespoon tomato paste
Wash the zucchini and hollow them out.
Mix the mince, washed rice, chopped onion and tomato paste.
Fill the zucchini without packing too tightly and arrange in a pot.
Add the water and cook for 40–45 minutes until the rice and mince are fully cooked.
Apple cinnamon oats
1 apple
4 tablespoons oats
Wash and grate the apple.
Cook the milk and oats in a small pot for 5 minutes.
Add the apple and stir for 3 more minutes.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and serve lukewarm.
Pasta with vegetables
200 g pasta
Boil the pasta according to the package instructions.
Chop the vegetables small and sauté in oil until soft.
Add the chopped tomato and cook for 5 minutes.
Mix the drained pasta with the sauce.
Lentil patties
Half a cup fine bulgur
Cook the lentils in water until completely soft.
Turn off the heat and add the bulgur; leave covered for 15 minutes.
Fry the onion with oil and tomato paste and add to the mixture.
When cool, knead and shape; store under hygienic conditions.
Baked vegetable omelette
Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Finely chop the zucchini and pepper; spread in a small greased dish.
Whisk the eggs and milk and pour over the vegetables.
Bake for about 18–22 minutes until no raw egg remains in the centre.
Beetroot yogurt salad
2 small beetroots
Wash the beetroots and boil until soft.
Peel and grate the cooled beetroots.
Mix the yogurt and crushed garlic.
Add the beetroot and serve with olive oil.
Leeks in olive oil
Wash the leeks well and slice; chop the carrot.
Stir the carrot in oil in a pot for 3 minutes.
Cook covered over low heat for about 30 minutes until soft.
Baked sea bass with lemon
2 cleaned sea bass fillets
2 sprigs parsley
Preheat the oven to 190 °C.
Place the fillets in a baking dish and add oil and lemon juice.
Bake for about 18–22 minutes until the fish is cooked through and flakes easily.
Check for bones and serve with parsley.
Chicken and vegetable sauté
Chop the chicken and vegetables small on separate boards.
Sauté the chicken in oil over high heat until browned.
Add the onion and vegetables and cook until soft.
Make sure the chicken’s internal temperature is at least 74 °C.
Orzo pilaf with mushrooms
1 cup orzo
200 g mushrooms
Clean and slice the mushrooms.
Sauté the onion and mushrooms in oil until the liquid evaporates.
Add the orzo and stir for 2 minutes.
Add the hot water and cook covered over low heat until absorbed.
Bulgur salad with green lentils
1 cup boiled green lentils
Soak the bulgur in hot water and let it swell covered for 10 minutes.
Wash and chop the cucumber and parsley.
Mix the boiled lentils with the bulgur.
Add the vegetables, lemon juice and oil and serve.
Baked zucchini gratin
Half a cup grated kashar
Preheat the oven to 190 °C; slice the zucchini thinly.
Arrange the zucchini in a baking dish.
Toast the butter and flour and add the milk gradually to make a thick sauce.
Add the sauce and cheese to the zucchini and bake for 30 minutes until the zucchini are soft.
White bean piyaz
Prepare the beans fully cooked and cooled.
Thinly slice the onion; chop the tomato and parsley.
Mix all the ingredients.
Add lemon and olive oil and serve fresh.
Baked apple crumble
3 apples
3 tablespoons flour
Chop the apples, mix with cinnamon and put in a dish.
Mix the oats, flour and cold butter until crumbly.
Sprinkle on top and bake for 25–30 minutes until the apples are soft.
Smoked eggplant with yogurt
Roast the eggplants in the oven at 220 °C until the skins blacken.
Let cool, peel and chop the flesh finely.
Add the eggplant and serve with olive oil.
Vegetable lentil casserole
Rinse the lentils, pre-boil for 15 minutes and drain.
Chop the onion, carrot and potato.
Combine the tomato paste, vegetables, lentils and water in a pot.
Cook for 25–30 minutes until the lentils and vegetables are completely soft.
Baked potatoes with minced meat
300 g minced meat
Preheat the oven to 200 °C; slice the potatoes thinly.
Fry the onion and mince in a pan until fully browned.
Layer the potatoes, mince and tomatoes in a baking dish.
Bake for 35–40 minutes until the potatoes are soft and the mince fully cooked.
Pear compote with cinnamon
3 pears
1 cinnamon stick
Wash the pears, remove the cores and slice.
Put the water and cinnamon in a pot and bring to a boil.
Add the pears and cook for 12–15 minutes until soft.
Add the lemon juice and serve chilled.
